Enjoy high-quality picture and pure audio by implementing the QualGear 50' (feet) HDMI cable with Ethernet in your AV setup. This cable meets HDMI 2. 0B specification and is backward compatible with all previous specifications - HDMI 1. 4, 1. 3, and 1. 0. This HDMI cable supports Ethernet and audio Return channels (ARC) so no separate cables are needed for Ethernet and audio Return capabilities.
